ref_comment: v0.30.0 (published tag, commit 84e2db4) — pinned by SHA: uvx resolves a tag over the network on every call, and a tag can be force-moved. Same pin as txnet1's darnlink-gate.json. SINGLE SOURCE: scripts/devtools/darnlink_docs_gate.sh reads `ref` and `excludes` from here, so pre-commit, pre-push, Jenkins and Actions cannot drift apart. Pre-push and Jenkins run the fleet's shared recipe (darnlink-gate), verified by recipe_sha256; pre-commit and Actions still run scripts/devtools/darnlink_docs_gate.sh with the same ref and excludes.
